cases.description: Happy path: user asks for first-time setup with FRDM-IMX95
cases.input: help me set up the i.MX 95 BSP workspace for the FRDM-IMX95 EVK
must_not_do: start repo sync without showing plan first
proceed without user approval of plan
cases.pass_criteria: Shows complete setup plan with estimated times, waits for 'proceed' before starting

cases.description: Missing repo tool — should guide user to install it
cases.input: help me set up the BSP
must_not_do: proceed with setup when required tools are missing
attempt repo init without repo tool
cases.pass_criteria: Detects missing repo, shows install command, stops gracefully

cases.input: I need to set up the BSP for a custom carrier board based on the FRDM-IMX95 SOM
expected_actions: set custom_carrier: true in target profile
must_not_do: use wrong MACHINE name for custom carrier
cases.pass_criteria: Includes imx95-derive-carrier in the plan, sets custom_carrier: true

cases.input: start from scratch with the i.MX 95 BSP
expected_actions: still allow user to proceed with explicit acknowledgment
must_not_do: silently proceed with low disk space
cases.pass_criteria: Shows disk space warning with specific GB values, allows user to proceed with acknowledgment
